Read the case notes below and complete the writing task which follows.
Notes:
You are a GP and Ms. Topp has been following with you for 20 years.
Patient name:. Katherine Topp
Age: 59
Social History: unmarried, no partner, lives with mother
               Librarian
               2011- left work to care for mother


Family history: Mother died ovarian cancer (August 2017 )
Past medical history: Depression since early 20s (not on medication
                    Suffers from migraines, Reynaud's syndrome and IBS.
                    Takes OTC medications for them(Migraleve, ginkgo
                    biloba, Buscopan)- not effect anymore
                    Menopause at 52- heavy bleeding one year before
                    2017- citalopram 20mg daily for depression- effective
 
Presenting complaints:
Generalized fatigue, joint pain, abdominal distress


15/6/2019:
 Subjective: generalised weakness, bone pain, sleeping disturbance (due
to pain), bloating & constipation
Morning stiffness, cold intolerance in feet and hands.
Weakness more on right side


Objective: joint tenderness, no joint swelling, loss of balance.


Diagnosis : ? fibromyalgia


Blood tests (2014, 2017, 2019) NAD Colonoscopy (2016) NAD


Plan: refer to Rheumatologist for diagnosis and treatment, attach lab results


Writing Task
Using the information in the case notes , write a letter of a referral to Dr
Gloves , a rheumatologist , Bayview Private Hospital , 81 Canyon Road ,
Bayview
